title: Mower Mayhem
tagline: Stripe ten walled lawns with your battery mower, zap the weeds with the trimmer and roll onto the dock before the power runs out.
blurb: Stripe ten walled lawns with your battery mower, zap the weeds with the trimmer and roll onto the dock before the power runs out. Steer round the flower beds and never, ever touch the hedgehogs, the cat or the birds. Dock on Lawn 10 for the victory card and a high score to beat.

quote.text: The mower turns the instant you touch Q A O P, and two keys at once take it round the diagonals

credits.name: Gaz Pocket, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
